body.provenance: Base colour re-baked (Cycles CPU, emission, selected-to-active) from the approved TRELLIS source mesh; there is no rear-view projection, so the far side and underside are as TRELLIS invented them from the single approved concept. Tangent normals baked from the source geometry and whiteout-blended with colour relief; AO baked from the decimated geometry; roughness lower on the darkest texels (beak and legs) and otherwise the glossy-feather default, both reduced by colour detail; no metal and no dye mask. Base colour lifted by luma power toneGamma (chroma ratios kept), set by eye in review renders. Artistic derivation, not measured PBR.

note: Crow in flight from concept candidate c and TRELLIS raw c-s6112 (already facing -Y), scaled to a 1.12 m wingspan. feetFraction 1 centres the bird on its whole outline (the lowest points are the drooping tail, not feet). Landmarks measured on the normalized mesh: wing roots at x 0.09, the wrist at x 0.3, tips at x 0.56 raised in a shallow dihedral.
textureNote: A crow is about 20-40 px tall in play: 256 px maps, baked at 512 and downsampled.
